welcomeModal.title: Maputo Protocol Safe Abortion Scorecard
welcomeModal.subtitle: Interactive Country Assessment Tool
welcomeModal.aboutParagraph1: This interactive web application enables comprehensive assessment of national alignment with the Maputo Protocol Article 14(2)(c) on safe abortion. The scorecard evaluates 46 indicators across 7 pillars, providing a systematic framework for measuring policy, service delivery, and equity dimensions of abortion care.
welcomeModal.aboutParagraph2: Developed in accordance with WHO 2022 Abortion Care Guidelines and the African Union Maputo Protocol, this tool supports evidence-based advocacy, policy monitoring, and regional benchmarking.

steps.title: Select Country
steps.description: Choose an African Union member state from the dropdown to begin assessment or load existing data.

steps.title: Score Indicators
steps.description: Rate each indicator on a 0-4 scale. Click info icons to view detailed scoring criteria and definitions.

steps.title: Add Evidence
steps.description: Document evidence sources, citations, and notes for each indicator to ensure transparency and traceability.

steps.title: Review & Export
steps.description: Analyze pillar scores, composite results, and insights. Export findings as Excel or PDF reports.
